v0.1:
- First release
- 20-move 3x3 scrambles using the hardware random number generator
- WCA-style 15 second inspection with 8s and 12s vibration calls, automatic +2 and DNF
- Center button solve timer, shown to the hundredth of a second
- Session stats: best single, current and best ao5 and ao12, last 12 solves
